page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.85 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core density and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for compute-bound workloads that require predictable, non-shared processing power without the overhead of hyperthreading. The low memory-to-CPU ratio makes it suitable for high-performance computing, batch processing, intensive CPU-bound simulations, and web serving workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local SSD storage.
